## Description
Briefly describe the change, its intent, and link any related issues.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] Documentation update or specification revision
- [ ] Sample / Example improvement

## Security & Quality Checklist
- [ ] **Zero-Secret Compliance:** I have verified this PR contains NO API secrets, private keys, database credentials, or sensitive merchant data.
- [ ] My code follows the established style conventions of this repository.
- [ ] I have updated corresponding documentation (`docs/`, `specifications/`, or `developers/`).
- [ ] All code samples use safe mock addresses and dummy test tokens.
- [ ] Existing automated checks and linters pass locally.
